$comment: OpenTodo's Railway template, as it is entered in Railway's template composer (Railway has no template file to import). scripts/deploy/railway.mjs checks it against deploy/deploy.json, and deploy/railway/README.md lists the dashboard steps. Guide: docs/self-hosting/railway.md
name: OpenTodo
description: Open-source, local-first task manager. Works offline and syncs every device from one small container.

variables.name: OPENTODO_BASE_URL
variables.description: The address people open. Passkeys, secure cookies and links in emails use it. Change it if you add a custom domain.

variables.name: OPENTODO_SETUP_TOKEN
variables.description: Asked once, when you create the owner account. Find it in this service's Variables tab.

variables.name: OPENTODO_ALLOW_SIGNUP
variables.description: true lets anyone who can reach the address create an account. Otherwise the owner invites people.

variables.name: OPENTODO_TRUSTED_PROXIES
variables.description: Leave empty on Railway: its edge proxy is the only hop.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: The port OpenTodo listens on; Railway routes and health-checks it. Do not change it.

variables.name: RAILWAY_RUN_UID
variables.description: Lets OpenTodo write to the volume: the image runs as a non-root user, and Railway's volumes are writable by root.
